patches.rationale: Register Vietnamese as a first-class desktop locale while keeping all translated product copy outside upstream core.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream exposes a distribution-owned locale registration seam.

patches.rationale: Ship the immutable edition receipt beside the upstream install stamp so a packaged artifact identifies both engine and Vietnamese shell inputs.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream exposes a distribution-owned provenance resource seam or natively packages an edition receipt.

patches.rationale: Prevent desktop chat turns from over-investigating simple questions or remaining permanently busy after setup and cleanup failures. The patch adds proportional-effort routing and a deterministic per-turn budget with no classifier model call: high-confidence simple questions receive at most 4 model rounds, ordinary turns 12, and explicit multi-step, attachment, synthesized, or active-goal work up to 30. Existing agent.max_turns and HERMES_TUI_MAX_TURNS values act only as tighter ceilings, background/CLI limits remain independent, and session settlement is non-skippable.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream ships proportional simple-question routing, a deterministic adaptive foreground budget independent of large job limits, and an exception-proof desktop turn settlement boundary with equivalent regressions.

patches.rationale: Complete the locked upstream desktop transport recovery for the exact 60-second timeout observed in V32 logs. The request timeout is tagged ETIMEDOUT so idempotent reads receive the existing bounded retry while a POST whose body was sent is never replayed.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream tags the Electron REST request timeout as ETIMEDOUT (or provides equivalent typed timeout recovery) with verb-safe regression coverage.

patches.rationale: Keep a one-round Desktop answer at one provider request by using the already-persisted deterministic opening prompt as the session title. The cosmetic LLM title upgrade remains available to non-Desktop surfaces; duplicate Desktop titles are resolved locally without another model request.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream exposes a surface-aware local-only title mode, or otherwise proves Desktop session naming never adds a provider request to a simple foreground turn.

patches.rationale: Package the exact receipt-bound engine, Python dependency closure, Node, uv, and browser helper inside the installer so first launch cannot clone pristine upstream, omit V33 hotfixes, spend minutes downloading dependencies, or stall at the bootstrap finalization boundary.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream ships a complete, provenance-bound resident desktop runtime with no first-launch dependency installation and an equivalent fail-closed payload gate.
